mutations.name: a single-quoted part is not noted as quoted
kills: bare spans of a spliced word records the unquoted ranges of a single-quoted value after a bare key

mutations.name: a double-quoted part is not noted as quoted
kills: bare spans of a spliced word records the unquoted ranges of a double-quoted part between bare text
bare spans of a spliced word records the unquoted ranges of a double-quoted variable before bare text

mutations.name: an escaped character is not noted as quoted
kills: bare spans of a spliced word records the unquoted ranges of an escape

mutations.name: an ANSI-C string is not noted as quoted
kills: bare spans of a spliced word records the unquoted ranges of an ANSI-C string before bare text

mutations.name: a word quoted whole also gets a span record
kills: bare spans of a spliced word keeps no record on a word read whole one way
